g.title: j2959858969
g.text: PapaPolar: so i sit down with that adorable little sugared-up squirrel, right?

g.title: j444969133
g.text: Who?

g.title: j3239816528
g.text: Lol. Hi, Velimir.

g.title: j4145898752
g.text: I'm going to assume you mean Amir.

g.title: j2352902009
g.text: PapaPolar: do i look like some colt gisney princess to you? who do you think i mean?

g.title: j3234402859
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2698447743
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3503673346
g.text: PapaPolar: the big-hearted zippy-de-doo-dah boy himself, amir

g.title: j2775536817
g.text: PapaPolar: heh, yeah. hey

g.title: j747466881
g.text: PapaPolar: well i'm sure as shit no colt gisney princess so i don't mean it literally lol

g.title: j3747474044
g.text: PapaPolar: anyway so i'm talking to him - or rather, he's talking AT me

g.title: j469451966
g.text: PapaPolar: ... which is something i get the feeling you fully understand ...

g.title: j257224916
g.text: PapaPolar: 'n he starts yabbering at me about some alternate dimension you're from??

g.title: j3424649369
g.text: Duviri. It's complicated.

g.title: j3017152185
g.text: Yeah, it's a long story.

g.title: j3352064098
g.text: PapaPolar: i got it at about eight bajillion miles per hour, don't friggin' worry about it, pal

g.title: j2812791160
g.text: PapaPolar: shit. i think i followed about a third of it. and the third i got, was a third too much. you need a hug, pal?

g.title: j3223309773
g.text: I'm all right. Doing better since I came here, weirdly.

g.title: j2006163872
g.text: Just don't snap my spine when you do it, big guy.

g.title: j3165249787
g.text: I'll never turn down a free hug.

g.title: j759272793
g.text: PapaPolar: glad you found somewhere that helped fill in the blanks. that's more than a lot of people get in life.

g.title: j4066003381
g.text: PapaPolar: HAH. free chiropractor visit, and now i have a built-in ice pack service

g.title: j3159814724
g.text: PapaPolar: good for you. life's too shit to turn down the things that make it better.

g.title: j2001867293
g.text: PapaPolar: home isn't where you were born, it isn't the people who raised you, it's the places and people that make you feel whole.

g.title: j4007350778
g.text: Check boolean MinervaVelimir1

g.title: j1123632282
g.text: Can I ask you what the deal is between you two and Rusalka?

g.title: j4007350778->j1123632282
g.text: true

g.title: j2720732264
g.text: Minerva still pissed at you?

g.title: j4007350778->j2720732264
g.text: true

g.title: j4007350778->j2720732264
g.text: false

g.title: j1283049706
g.text: So... Are you and Minerva... A thing?

g.title: j4007350778->j1283049706
g.text: false

g.title: j4067256973
g.text: PapaPolar: since she's still off being pissed at me, i suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you

g.title: j1817490947
g.text: PapaPolar: when isn't she...

g.title: j2473507253
g.text: Boolean MinervaVelimir1 is now true.

g.title: j3923487418
g.text: Boolean MinervaNeci3a is now true.

g.title: j1675644327
g.text: PapaPolar: she has her reasons, though. trust me. i don't make it easy on her.

g.title: j535237223
g.text: PapaPolar: mmm. kinda. we were married, but not really anymore. on paper only. somewhere. in some country that stopped existing circa 1982?

g.title: j613318846
g.text: PapaPolar: we were overseas in a lil town a few countries south of here. place got blown to bits. found a little girl there. just a tiny thing, knee high, all red hair and pissed as a kicked hive of bees

g.title: j917679871
g.text: Check boolean MinervaVelimir1

g.title: j796613958
g.text: PapaPolar: does that count?

g.title: j2470515156
g.text: PapaPolar: she tried to stab me six times with a spoon bahahaha cutest lil thing you've ever seen.

g.title: j917679871->j4067256973
g.text: true

g.title: j3192863853
g.text: PapaPolar: you can probably see it plain as day, the two of us used to be a "thing." married, actually.

g.title: j917679871->j3192863853
g.text: false

g.title: j3603248855
g.text: That explains the arguing I guess.

g.title: j48346641
g.text: Yeah, doesn't seem like you two are still together.

g.title: j4078428223
g.text: PapaPolar: had this little stuffed rabbit toy she was clinging to, though. M told her she'd protect it with her life 'n keep it safe.

g.title: j2923168105
g.text: Boolean MinervaVelimir1 is now true.

g.title: j361491278
g.text: PapaPolar: when neci left to go join scaldra... things weren't ever the same between us. it was the last straw, i think.

g.title: j2129821425
g.text: PapaPolar: what gave it away.

g.title: j1364803981
g.text: PapaPolar: that got neci's trust real fast. ran right for M and threw her arms around her. we quit the military then. well. officially. became "consultants."

g.title: j3409231641
g.text: PapaPolar: but now it's just a thing on paper. and i suppose that since that country ceased to exist circa 1982, you can decide if it still counts at all anyway

g.title: j907667760
g.text: PapaPolar: she took one look at scaldra and called a spade a spade. saw it for what it was. dangerous. a cult.

g.title: j452775666
g.text: PapaPolar: so... we raised her as our own. think of her as our daughter, even though she isn't.

g.title: j1398970530
g.text: PapaPolar: and moreover, something that was gonna get our little girl killed. but... i said she wasn't a kid anymore.

g.title: j2903271682
g.text: PapaPolar: when neci said she wanted to join some military mercenary faction and said they really believed in something? M said no.

g.title: j271503061
g.text: PapaPolar: i... gave her my blessing to leave.

g.title: j1701207819
g.text: PapaPolar: told M... to "have a little faith" har har...

g.title: j3181643657
g.text: PapaPolar: thought maybe that neci saw something in that viktor guy, maybe she'd find somebody like i found somebody...

g.title: j4210126039
g.text: PapaPolar: whep.

g.title: j4072964592
g.text: This isn't your fault.

g.title: j429733310
g.text: Oh...

g.title: j1856061024
g.text: I'm so sorry.

g.title: j153177288
g.text: PapaPolar: thanks. but i told her to get onto that sinking ship, and it sunk. minerva saw the holes. i chose to ignore them

g.title: j3478470647
g.text: PapaPolar: big, typical, stupid me. doing typical big, stupid me things.

g.title: j4256052070
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3549803319
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1021803453
g.text: PapaPolar: blegh. i need a cold one. gonna go throw a few back. ttyl.

g.title: j1776588876
g.text: PapaPolar: thanks. tried to let my little girl run free, and lost my whole family over it.

g.title: j1783467404
g.text: PapaPolar: but i appreciate the sentiment, i do.

g.title: j1972364092
g.text: +20 Chemistry
